cards.name: Chrono-Saur Dactylus
cards.audit_note: Rejected the reported Spell/Trap Zone Dinosaur finding. Official 'Dinosaur monster in your hand or field' handling uses LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_MZONE; a Monster Card being treated as a Spell/Trap is not a Dinosaur monster on the field. Chrono-Saur cards remain separately covered from any on-field zone.

coverage_override.reason: The three activated effects each incorporate their own clause of the final each-effect HOPT sentence.

effects.printed_clause: During the Battle Phase, if a "Chrono-Saur" card or a Dinosaur monster in your hand or field was destroyed by card effect this turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, but negate its effects. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A global EVENT_DESTROYED observer records effect destruction of a Chrono-Saur card from hand or any on-field zone, or a Dinosaur monster from hand/Monster Zone; during the Battle Phase the HOPT hand Quick Effect summons this card and negates it.

official_references.matched_structure: Official 'Dinosaur monster in your hand or field' effect searches LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_MZONE and requires the Dinosaur race, excluding Spell/Trap Zones.
Official hand trigger Special Summons its handler with standard zone and summon-legality checks.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Special Summoned: You can target up to 2 cards your opponent control; destroy them. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed HOPT EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS trigger targets one or two opponent on-field cards and destroys the still-related targets.

official_references.matched_structure: Official summon-success trigger uses a hard once-per-turn code and targeted operation structure.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Chrono-Saur" monster from your hand or GY, except "Chrono-Saur Dactylus". You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed HOPT EVENT_DESTROYED trigger requires REASON_EFFECT and summons one different legal archetype monster from hand or Necrovalley-permitted GY.

official_references.matched_structure: Official delayed EVENT_DESTROYED trigger checks destruction circumstances and performs a follow-up archetype operation.
